name: ensoniqplay
description: ensoniqplay(1) M1 placed playback: upload a raw 8-bit PCM sample into the Ensoniq 5503 DOC wave RAM and play it once through a single one-shot oscillator (no streaming, no sound IRQ).  The fixture tone440.pcm is a 0.5 s, 440 Hz sine at 22050 Hz (11025 bytes, 8-bit unsigned).  The player prints its setup line -- byte count, requested rate, and the DOC frequency word it computed (freq 429 = round(22050*512/26320)) -- which proves the upload path and the sample-rate->DOC-freq math.  It then waits on the oscillator's control-register halt bit and reports how many 60 Hz ticks the one-shot took to finish; a placed sample of 11025 bytes at 22050 Hz should halt after ~30 ticks, so 'halted' proves the DOC actually clocked through the whole sample at the programmed rate.  The story stages at test time.
